clue.text: Medieval tournament, not old, is fair

indicators.note: not here tells us to leave out the letter for old from the tournament word

parts.note: a joust was a medieval contest between mounted knights

explanation.surface: A judgement that a knightly contest, though not ancient, was conducted fairly.
explanation.definitionFit: Just and fair are synonyms describing treatment that is equitable and right.

clue.text: Couple jibe endlessly about average man in the street

indicators.note: about suggests the letters are turned around and rearranged
endlessly means the final letter of jibe is dropped

explanation.surface: A pair mock an ordinary passer-by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts the last letter from JIBE to leave JIB, and 'about' shuffles COUPLE with JIB.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is British slang for the ordinary member of the public, a typical citizen.

clue.text: Number of orders booked many years ago

definitions.text: Number of orders booked many years ago

parts.words: Number of orders booked many years ago
parts.note: a count of divine laws written down in the Bible long ago

explanation.walkthrough: 'booked' suggests a reservation but means written in a book, the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: The Decalogue is the set of laws given to Moses and recorded in the Book of Exodus.

clue.text: Show's former location

parts.note: ex means former, as in an ex-partner
a position is a place or location

explanation.surface: Reads as a note that an exhibition used to be held somewhere else.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An exposition is a large public exhibition, such as a world's fair.

clue.text: Group of organisms, green sort

parts.note: eco- means environmentally friendly, green
a sort is a type or kind

explanation.surface: A biologist classes some organisms as a green kind.
explanation.definitionFit: In ecology, the term names a population adapted to its local environment.

clue.text: Display insect under leaf

indicators.note: under in a down clue puts the insect below the leaf

parts.note: a leaf of a book is a page
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: Showing a bug beneath a leaf.
explanation.definitionFit: A pageant is an elaborate public spectacle or procession.

clue.text: Hurried round fish, kept it moist

indicators.note: round means the hurried word goes around the fish

parts.note: sped means hurried
a ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: Someone rushed about a fish, keeping it wet.
explanation.definitionFit: Spraying something with fine water droplets keeps it damp.

clue.text: Judging people's feelings is what one might be doing getting into bath

definitions.text: what one might be doing getting into bath
definitions.meaning: literally dipping a toe to check the bath's temperature

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means sounding out reactions in advance, from checking water before bathing.

clue.text: Old province of birth

definitions.meaning: a former province of South Africa

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective relates to being born; the province was named for Christmas Day, Christ's birthday.

clue.text: Plainchant in service

parts.note: plain can mean even or flat, as a level surface
a chant is a kind of song

explanation.surface: Plainchant, the unaccompanied medieval church singing, is used during a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: The word 'Plainchant' must be split into PLAIN and CHANT, each giving a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the Anglican evening prayer service, so it is a kind of church service.

clue.text: Right in front of you and me, hard apple

indicators.note: in front of places the letter for right before the following pieces

parts.note: you and me together are us
set means hardened, as concrete sets

explanation.surface: Someone picks out a firm apple sitting just ahead of the two of us.
explanation.definitionFit: Russet is a variety of apple with rough brownish skin.

clue.text: Wicked nuns stripped in front of Christmas decoration — heartless!

indicators.note: in front of puts the stripped nuns before the decoration
stripped means the outer letters of the word nuns are taken off, leaving its middle
heartless means the central letter of the decoration word is removed

parts.note: holly sprigs are a traditional Christmas decoration

explanation.surface: A shocking scene of undressed nuns by the Christmas decorations, condemned as heartless.
explanation.definitionFit: Unholy means sinful or wicked, opposed to what is sacred.

clue.text: American representative not characteristic

parts.note: representative of a group means typical of it

explanation.surface: A US congressman behaving out of character.
explanation.definitionFit: Atypical means unusual, departing from the normal pattern.

clue.text: Back at sea

parts.note: the rear of a ship in nautical language

explanation.definitionFit: Sailors call the rear part of a vessel this, the stern end.

clue.text: Toil with same ground that is most fertile

indicators.note: ground, as in milled or crushed, tells us the letters of toil and same are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Working the same patch of soil, which is the richest farmland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' looks like the noun for soil but is the anagram signal; 'that is' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Loam is rich crumbly soil, so the loamiest soil is the richest for growing.

clue.text: Fingers perhaps something found in excavations

indicators.note: found in means the word for something sits inside the excavations word

parts.note: archaeological excavations are called digs
it can stand for an unspecified thing

explanation.surface: Archaeologists unearth bones, perhaps finger bones, at their dig sites.
explanation.definitionFit: Fingers are examples of digits, the word for fingers and toes; 'perhaps' marks the example.

clue.text: Older lamb's family's fleece

parts.note: a lamb grown older is a sheep, and the possessive gives sheep's
kin means family; the 's stands for is, linking to the definition

explanation.surface: Says a grown lamb's relatives have woolly coats.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleece is the woolly coat of a sheep, used as a skin with the wool on.

clue.text: Felix's short sleep?

parts.note: Felix is a famous cartoon cat, so his brief doze is a cat's nap

explanation.surface: Wonders what kind of nap Felix takes.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief daytime doze is commonly named after the way felines sleep.

clue.text: Round bit?

parts.note: a section of a circle, a round shape

explanation.definitionFit: A portion of a circle's circumference is a curve segment.

clue.text: Be first individual to enter wharf

indicators.note: to enter means the individual word goes inside the wharf word

parts.note: a pier is a landing stage or wharf
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: Urges someone to be the first person stepping onto a quay.
explanation.definitionFit: To pioneer something is to lead the way, doing it before anyone else.

clue.text: Reportedly eavesdrop in this direction

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word for eavesdrop is heard rather than seen

parts.note: to eavesdrop is to listen in, to catch speech by chance

explanation.surface: Listening in on talk while someone calls you this way.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone over to where you stand directs them this way.

clue.text: Offer more in order to take the lot?

definitions.text: Offer more in order to take the lot?

parts.words: Offer more in order to take the lot?
parts.note: at an auction, a lot is an item for sale; bidding too high to win it

explanation.walkthrough: 'take the lot' suggests grabbing everything, but a lot is one item at an auction.
explanation.definitionFit: Bidding higher than an item is worth, or than rivals, to secure it at auction.

clue.text: Not easily disturbed by question and answer in rising river

indicators.note: in places question and answer inside the river
rising in a down clue means the river's name is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: the Elbe is a river in Germany

explanation.surface: Someone calm under questioning beside a swelling river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns ELBE into EBLE, and 'in' sets QUA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An equable temperament is calm and even, not readily upset.

clue.text: Gossip with school facing lows, it's said

indicators.note: facing puts the school abbreviation in front of the second piece
it's said tells us the word for lows is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: cows low, meaning they moo

explanation.surface: Chat at school while cattle moo nearby, so the story goes.
explanation.definitionFit: To schmooze is to chat in a friendly, ingratiating way, much like casual talk.

clue.text: Young fellow in charge of sound

parts.note: a son is a young male, a boy

explanation.surface: A boy is put in charge of the audio.
explanation.definitionFit: Sonic means relating to sound waves or audible noise.

clue.text: Open a French shawl

parts.note: un is French for a
a wrap is a shawl worn round the shoulders

explanation.surface: Someone opens a gift of a French shawl.
explanation.definitionFit: To unwrap a parcel is to open it by taking off its covering.

clue.text: Subtle difference when one's leaving pest

indicators.note: leaving means the letters for one's go out of the pest word

parts.note: a pest is a nuisance
one is I, and one's means one is, giving I and S

explanation.surface: Noting a slight change for the better when an annoying person goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuance is a fine shade of meaning or distinction.

clue.text: It is said to be coming from young child

definitions.text: It is said to be coming from young child

parts.words: It is said to be coming from young child
parts.note: the words spoken by an infant, or the cooing adults use with one

explanation.definitionFit: The simplified speech of toddlers, imitated by doting adults, has a fixed name.

clue.text: Pastime building card-castle

indicators.note: building suggests the letters of card-castle are assembled in a new order

explanation.surface: A hobby of stacking playing cards into a castle.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a string game played by looping string between the fingers, a children's amusement.

clue.text: Weather when sun god is not out?

parts.note: Ra is the Egyptian sun god
in cricket, a batsman who is not out is still in

explanation.surface: Asks what weather comes when the sun stays hidden.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman who is not out is still in.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainfall is a kind of weather, the opposite of a sunny day.
